Where the requester named no threshold, as with the running length in A-010, the criterion states the floor the inputs support and Q-001 and Q-002 carry the residue rather than a number being invented.

SN2.basis: Every in-scope item traces to a statement in the feature request or the business intent, except S-011, which traces to the change request's own record of the command contract and is marked should-have. Adjacent matters the inputs raise but do not request, being the onboarding cut, were sent to Q-005 rather than into the In Scope table.

SN3.basis: The business goal restates the outcome the business intent states it is buying, that a presenter can show the framework with evidence rather than assertions and without a day of preparation. No mechanism and no inferred objective was added; the demanding audience requirement the requester named drove S-008 rather than being softened.
